answer_1.quote: Neural generative dialog models have a tendency to produce generic, safe responses, such as 'I don't know' .

answer_2.quote: We use the single-reference and multi-reference automatic evaluation framework for DailyDialog released by , which is computed using NLG-EVAL . We primarily consider multi-reference METEOR ; see Appendix A.7 for all metrics.

answer_4.quote: For human evaluation of the different systems we use crowdworkers on Amazon Mechanical Turk to judge the fluency, coherence, and interestingness of utterances on a 1-5 Likert scale (see Appendix A.4 for full details) for 100 randomly sampled evaluation set prompts.
answer_4.guideline: judge the fluency, coherence, and interestingness of utterances on a 1-5 Likert scale
